correctness.rationale: Direct polynomial matrices establish determinant degree and exact endpoints; the socle pairing is an off-diagonal even/odd block at harmonic parameters; the cross-block has determinant (-1)^m binomial(m+2,2), congruent to ±15/8 mod p and nonzero for p>=7, giving exact rank p-7. GL2 covariance and Frobenius justify all harmonic parameters. A triangular lambda=0 degeneration gives maximal rank in every graded piece and therefore generic total rank (p-6)^2. Actual checker passed eight primes; no infinite inference relies on experiments.

originality.rationale: The exact-degree divisor and universal rank-(p-7) harmonic corank-one statement are not present in the compared primary results. Cook (2011) and Lundqvist-Nicklasson (2016) address the Lefschetz property for powers of linear forms; Glasby-Praeger-Xia (2014) addresses tensor products of Jordan blocks, again not a four-line quartic cross-ratio parameter. Dimca-Sticlaru (2020) locates harmonic forms by complex Waring rank using apolarity; this does not give characteristic-p truncated-algebra multiplication ranks or the degree 3(p-6) divisor. Prior rank/Jordan classifications in other truncated and exterior algebras differ in ring, characteristic and operator family. A broader unknown theorem may still imply the claim; priority is provisional.

value.rationale: For the canonical modular group algebra of an elementary abelian group of rank two, the third power of a four-line quartic has a genuine nontrivial rank-jumping divisor of degree 3(p-6). A uniform harmonic corank-one family exists for every p>=7 *within the squarefree root-configuration locus*, proving nonconstant nilpotent Jordan type despite identical root multiplicities. This is a natural modular-algebra invariant and a structural, all-prime result rather than a small parameter enumeration.
